In stock TURD FUZZ quantity Add to cart Category: GUITAR EFFECTS COLLECTION Tags: Dr. No Dr.No Effects Fart Pedal Fuzz Guitar Effect Handmade Turd Fuzz Description Video Additional information Description TURD Fuzz by Dr. No Effects Dr. No releases yet another invention to add to his unique unconventional collection of handmade Guitar Effects, the TURD Fuzz. Dr. No Effects tried to be successful in bringing you the shittiest guitar pedal in the world of guitar effects. Unfortunately Dr. No partially failed in doing so… The TURD Fuzz is a turd shaped pedal making it a shitty pedal indeed made of soft foam material, that when stepped on engages the effect, but this soft textured TURD Fuzz pedal houses a excellent extreme cool fuzz effect, were the doctor is known for. The handmade circuit contains a pair of two NOS transistors that generate this nasty old fashioned fuzz tone, that works very well with guitar and bass guitar. The Turd Fuzz has no volume or other dail knobs as it is set to go! It cleans up very smooth when using the guitar volume. This TURD Fuzz is a collaboration with artist Peter van Elderen, (Peter Pan Speedrock, Home Steel), who worked together on this smelly collaboration that resulted in this unique awesome sounding FUZZ. The TURD Fuzz works on a 9v external 2.1mm power-supply. Also on top of the TURD Fuzz a custom made Fly is added, that functions as a on/off indicator instead of a standard led indicator. The eyes of the fly light up when stepping on to the TURD Fuzz, and engaging the effect. The TURD Fuzz is fully handmade in Dr. No’s lab from soft TURD enclosure and internal sonic design as well as the custom made and designed TURD Fuzz box. The Turd is made of soft and spongy foam to easily engage the internal build in footswitch. The Turd Fuzz is made with very durable and strong foam material to last. Price incl. MINI TURD FUZZ quantity Add to cart Category: GUITAR EFFECTS COLLECTION SKU: 100 Tags: Boutique Guitar Effects Dr.No Effects Fuzz Pedal Guitar Effects Hnadmade Guitar Effects Mini Turd Fuzz Turd Fuzz Turd Shaped Guitar Effect Description Video Additional information Description NEW SERIES AVAILABLE NOW! Because of the great succes of the TURD shaped pedals in foam version, I decided to make a few run’s of MINI TURD FUZZ with a more “pedalboard friendly” housing. As a bonus an added external Fuzz Volume knob in the Original Turd shape. Many musicians asked about a “pedalboard friendly unit. As a bonus we added an external Fuzz Volume knob in the famous TURD shape. The Mini TURD FUZZ, uses a 9v powersupply. The Fuzz itself is a two (silicon) BC109C Transistor Fuzz that is mean and loud but works perfectly with the added Fuzz Volume to set back gain as well as it works great with dailing back your guitar volume pot. Fuzz in it’s purist form. All handmade with great care and one year unlimited warranty. The Mini TURD FUZZ comes in a custommade cartboard box with a cotton slikscreened bag, including a Dr. No Effects sticker set and a Keychain. Price incl. FREE WORLD WIDE SHIPPING!
